plugins.name: openjdk-helper
plugins.description: Read-only tools for OpenJDK contributors and project leads: census roles, pull requests, issues and backports, JEPs, release schedules and project processes. Connects to the free hosted OpenJDK Helper MCP service; no account, Java runtime or local server needed.

plugins.name: mnemic
plugins.description: Persistent local memory shared by all your AI assistants: what you told them, kept as dated facts in one SQLite file on your machine and recalled before they answer. Runs locally from a bundled binary for macOS Apple silicon and Windows x64; no account or service.

plugins.name: email-mcp
plugins.description: Read, search, triage and draft email over IMAP and SMTP. Runs locally; sending and permanent deletion are off by default. The Claude Code plugin uses a native bundle for macOS Apple silicon and Windows x64.
